posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: Their reactions to my deluge of meat puns was almost exactly what I had hoped for, with Adam moaning and writhing while Christopher chortled with suppressed glee.  I did hope they'd say that such a universe couldn't possibly exist, though--Adam because he never wants to be asked to draw it, and Christopher because they'd already established that the Iron Legacy timeline was the wurst.
